---

**bcftools view raw.bcf (illumina)-> raw.vcf**
bcftools view: view or convert bcf or vcf file
-0 v: tells bcftools to convert to vcf file
-o file.vcf: name of output file
file.bcf: name of input file

```{bash}
bcftools view -O v -o chromosome_file.vcf chromosome_file.bcf
```

**convert vcf -> ped**
plink: package used
--vcf file.vcf: name of input file
--recode: tells plink to convert to ped/map file
--out file: name of output file

```{bash}
plink --vcf chromsome_file.vcf --recode --out chromsome_file
```

**convert .ped and .map files to .bed, .bim, and .fam**
--file: input .ped and .map name
--make-bed: tells plink to make .bed, .bim, and .fam files
--out: name of new .bed, .bim, .fam files

```{bash}
plink --file chromsome_file --make-bed --out chromsomes_file
```
